name: Almea
bio: Almea's destiny was to become a member of the Royal Conclave, like her parents and their parents before them. She hated the sound of that destiny. So as soon as she turned 18, she stole her family's heirloom frost sword and hightailed it out of the Emerald Kingdom. She's now a travelling mercenary, fighting across Amara with two Orcs as her muscle. If her parents could see her now.
